resources.string: When you pop marbles, a gauge fills up: it is the golden ring around the waiting marble. When it is full, a special marble arrives at the launcher. The bomb (from level 2) pops all the marbles around the spot it hits. The rainbow (from level 3) takes the colour that makes the biggest group with its neighbours. The lightning (from level 4) pops all the marbles of the colour it hits, along the whole path. The marbles they pop earn points and can start a chain reaction. The path enters from an edge of the board and the hole can be anywhere: it changes at every level.
